landing.hero_desc: Deploy enterprise-grade email security that identifies sophisticated threats before they reach your inbox. No complex setup, just pure protection.
landing.features_desc: We target the human element of security, neutralizing attacks before they exploit your team.
landing.feat_links_desc: Real-time inspection of every URL in every email. We follow redirections and analyze final destinations to detect malicious intent.
landing.feat_identity_desc: Protection against Business Email Compromise (BEC) with advanced sender identity mapping and behavioral anomaly detection.
landing.feat_remediation_desc: No need to wait for the IT team. Our platform automatically retrieves malicious emails from all connected inboxes in under 2 seconds.
landing.dark_desc: IT leaders deserve a tool that speaks their language. Sicurre offers granular control without the complexity of legacy security suites.
landing.dark_check_1: API-first integration for O365 & Google Workspace
landing.dark_check_2: Invisible mode for zero user-flow impact
landing.cta_section_desc: Join hundreds of leaders who sleep better knowing their email gateway is protected by Sicurre.
landing.cta_no_card: No credit card required. Up and running in under 5 minutes.
landing.footer_tagline: The French sovereign anti-phishing protection solution for modern SMBs.
landing.footer_slogan: Secure protection for the modern enterprise.
